描述_EN: good burials showed gratitude to the spirits of the universe and established the reputation of the dead ones in the afterworld. bronze was one of the most important of the many materials used for grave goods. this figure of an owl represents a type of ritual bronze vessel called zun, used for storing wine in tombs in order that the dead could continue offering sacrifices to the gods and ancestors.
描述_ZN: 好的墓葬显示了对宇宙神灵的感激，并建立了死者在后世的声誉。 青铜是用于墓葬用品的众多材料中最重要的一种。 这个猫头鹰的形象代表了一种叫做 "尊 "的青铜礼器，用来在墓中储存酒，以便死者能够继续向神和祖先献祭。
